newsitem.title: USA: CBOE to list options July 24 on Nice System ADRs.
newsitem.headline: CBOE to list options July 24 on Nice System ADRs.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange said Thursday it will list options July 24 on Nice Systems Ltd American depositary receipts.

Nice options will trade on the January cycle, with introductory expiries in August, September, October and January. Initial strike prices are set at 30, 35 and 40. Group One Trading LP was named designated primary market maker.

Nice Systems Ltd, headquartered in Israel, develops, designs, makes, markets and services digital recording and retrieval systems that simultaneously record and monitor communications from multiple channels. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
